tachiyomisy.description:
TachiyomiSY is a free and open-source manga reader for Android, built on Mihon and originally derived from TachiyomiAZ. It expands the manga reading experience with advanced library management, powerful customization, and features inspired by other popular manga reader forks.

Read manga online through compatible, separately installed source extensions or enjoy downloaded chapters offline. Organize your library using custom and dynamic categories, search filters, drag-and-drop sorting, and reading progress tracking. A flexible reader offers multiple reading directions, automatic webtoon detection, customizable page preloading, and autoscrolling.

Additional features include manga recommendations, source migration, editing manga information, merging entries from different sources, advanced source management, and tracking integration with services such as MyAnimeList and AniList. Light and dark themes, backup and restore, and scheduled library updates provide further convenience.

TachiyomiSY requires Android 8.0 or newer. It does not supply manga content or source extensions by default; users must configure compatible sources and respect applicable content rights. The project is open source under the Apache 2.0 license.
